finding: PRE-REGISTERED POLICY for infrastructure aborts (exit=-11 SIGSEGV, exit=-9 OOM). An abort is NOT a task failure and NOT a pass — it is an infrastructure event. Policy: (1) retry on infrastructure abort, (2) log the abort with its cause, (3) count ONLY completed trials toward k, (4) record attempt count separately, (5) if aborts cluster on a candidate (>=2), that is an exclusion signal in its own right, not a verdict. Rationale: without this, a retry-pass silently vanishes the aborted attempt and the k=3 denominator quietly becomes k=3-of-4-attempts — decided in favour of whichever outcome makes the table look finished.
why_not_fixed: n/a — this is a policy registration, not a fix. Must be enforced in the runner's trial loop when it distinguishes infra-abort from task-fail.

finding: C2 (migration 63) is a TASK-DEFECT, not a model failure and not an infra abort — a third category. The original 43s session completed because it had context the reconstructed one-liner dropped. The replay agent correctly refused to hallucinate the third table.
